question:
**Direction: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Desert
solution:
The correct answer is **"Populate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Desert" means to leave somebody/something, usually for ever. (किसी को (प्रायः सदा के लिए) छोड़ जाना)
 
 
• Example: *Many people have **deserted**__ the countryside and moved to the towns.*
 
 
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning to the given word is "populate."
 
• The word "Populate" means to fill a particular area with people. (किसी स्‍थान में आबादी होना)
 __
 
• Example: *Parts of the country are very thinly **populated**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bereft: **completely lacking something; having lost something. (पूर्णतया रहित; से हीन या वंचित)
 
• **Forlorn: **lonely and unhappy; not cared for. (अकेला और उदास; उपेक्षित)
 
• **Migrate: **(used about a large number of people) to go and live and work in another place. ((बड़ी संख्‍या में लोगों का) अन्‍य स्‍थान पर जाना, वहाँ रहना और काम करना)
